---
title: "Penguin Explorer"
---

Explore the relationship between penguin bill length and body mass using the
Palmer Penguins dataset.

This is a learning project following Alex K. Gold's
[DevOps for Data Science](https://do4ds.com/).

## Chapter 1: Environments as Code

The first chapter builds two analysis pages:

- An exploratory analysis in R.
- A model of penguin body mass in Python.

Each language will use a project-specific package environment, with its
dependencies recorded so that the environment can be restored later.

Both analysis pages and their project-specific package environments are now in
place. Our next step is to verify that the recorded environment files can
restore the project reproducibly.
